description: handle_email_import: after JMAP-4ii.70 fixed args.get() to args.remove() (making emails owned), the loop at line 1721 still iterates by borrow: for (import_id, entry) in &emails. This forces import_id.clone() on every error path (4 sites). Since emails is an owned Map (moved out of args), the loop can consume it: for (import_id, entry) in emails. This gives import_id as an owned String, eliminating all 4 clones. The fix is a one-character change (&emails → emails).
title: email_import: consuming loop iteration to avoid id_str.clone()
